answer: In epoch 122, test identities by commons stewardship: place small, randomly mixed groups in charge of one reef in a shared lagoon, where each may harvest tokens but overharvesting kills the reef for everyone next season, whose timing stays unpredictable. Honest strangers restrain themselves noisily and imperfectly, arguing and adjusting. One operator behind many masks either scripts greed and strips the reef, or coordinates restraint too perfectly, with identical margins group after group. Reward living reefs, and drop an anchor on that too-perfect fingerprint: it exposes the farm.
